title: Tinyfolk (chibi peasant hero)
aesthetic: A chibi over-world hero, ~2 heads tall, built the hybrid way: the VOLUMES are a shaded form-skeleton (a big sphere head, capsule limbs, a box torso and jerkin) the engine lights and connects by construction, so the little peasant is poseable and animatable; the FACE is a hand-pixelled overlay pinned over the head (hair fringe, big glossy eyes, rosy cheeks, mouth) — the iconographic bits a shaded solid can't express. A gentle three-quarter / isometric turn (torso skew + a staggered stance + features nudged to the near side) sits him in a world rather than flat on the screen. Earthy peasant palette: linen tunic, brown leather jerkin, rope belt, patched trousers, cloth boots.
